$comment: Addresses are sourced from third-party listings (Yelp, Copper Mountain's own dining page, Restaurant Guru, Summit Chamber) and corroborated across at least two of them, with the phone numbers matching. VERIFY before printing anything. Hours found on those same aggregators are recorded under `hoursUnverified` but deliberately NOT displayed: they disagree with each other, they are the kind of thing that shifts every season in a ski town, and sending someone over a pass to a locked door is worse than saying 'call'. Move a block into `hours` once the business confirms it, and the site will start showing it.
